rca of the issue: Previously: default_tailwind_config assumed palette was always list[str] of hex codes, but the LLM-fallback path passed a dict {primary, secondary, accent}, raising TypeError when slicing. Fix added shape detection: dict → map semantic keys to brand-primary/secondary/accent then pad brand-N; list → original behavior; None/empty → defaults. The fallback now returns brand_dna_used=True with a valid tailwind.config.ts. Verified by the targeted test plus the full 56-test run.
